Build-Depends: debhelper-compat (= 14), cmake, libdtk6gui-dev, libdtk6widget-dev, libmtdev-dev, libqt6xdg-dev, libqt6xdgiconloader-dev, libx11-dev, pkgconf, qt6-base-dev, qt6-base-private-dev, qt6-svg-dev
Description: Qt 6 theme integration plugins for DDE Deepin's dde-qtintegration provides Qt plugins that integrate Qt applications with the Deepin Desktop Environment (DDE) and the Deepin Tool Kit (DTK): the "deepin" platform theme plugin, which applies the DDE font, colour and icon theme settings; the "chameleon" widget style; icon engines for DTK icons and SVG icons; and image format plugins for the DCI icon format and SVG. . This package provides the Qt 6 (DTK6) plugins. . This package is part of DDE (Deepin Desktop Environment).
